name: What metrics should I track to measure the success of GEO implementation?
description: Track local search rankings, geographic website traffic, map pack appearances, local CTR and conversion rates, and engagement on local listings.

mainEntity.name: What metrics should I track to measure the success of GEO implementation?

acceptedAnswer.text: To measure the success of your GEO implementation, track metrics such as local search ranking improvements for targeted keywords, website traffic from specific geographic areas, and the number of local map pack appearances. Also monitor click-through rates (CTR) and conversion rates (e.g., calls, direction requests, form submissions) from local campaigns. Reviewing customer reviews and engagement on local listings also provides valuable insights into local impact.
acceptedAnswer.description: Track local search rankings, geographic website traffic, map pack appearances, local CTR and conversion rates, and engagement on local listings.
